description_en: Queries the approval processes under the current Alibaba Cloud account
description_zh: 查询当前阿里云账号下审批流程列表
name: ListApprovalProcesses

parameters.help_en: The page number of the current page for paging in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 10000
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时显示的当前页的页码。取值：1~10000
parameters.name: current_page

parameters.help_en: The paging Settings for the number of entries to return on each page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 500
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页数量。取值：1~500
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the approval process. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-). Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh: 审批流程名称。长度为1~128个字符，支持中文和大小写英文字母，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）。支持模糊匹配
parameters.name: process_name

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the approval processes. A maximum of 100 approval process IDs are supported
parameters.help_zh: 审批流程ID集合。最多支持100个审批流程ID
parameters.name: process_ids

parameters.help_en:
The type of the business policy. Valid values:
DomainBlacklist: Domain name blacklist.
DomainWhitelist: Domain name whitelist.
SoftwareBlock: Software blocking.
AppUninstall: Endpoint uninstallation.
DlpSend: File export.
PeripheralBlock: Peripheral control
parameters.help_zh:
业务策略类型。取值：
DomainBlacklist：域名黑名单。
DomainWhitelist：域名白名单。
SoftwareBlock：软件禁用。
AppUninstall：终端卸载。
DlpSend：文件外发。
PeripheralBlock：外设管控
parameters.name: policy_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the associated business policy. If you specify this parameter, you must also specify the PolicyType parameter
parameters.help_zh: 关联业务策略ID。使用该参数时必须同时指定 PolicyType
parameters.name: policy_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the approver, which starts with su_. Only approval processes that include this approver in the approval nodes are returned. Value source:
[ListUsers](~~ListUsers~~): Queries users
parameters.help_zh:
审批人ID，以 su_ 开头。仅返回审批节点中包含该审批人的审批流程。取值来源：
[ListUsers](~~ListUsers~~)：批量查询用户
parameters.name: sase_user_id

parameters.help_en: The username of the approver. Fuzzy match is supported. Only approval processes that include this approver in the approval nodes are returned
parameters.help_zh: 审批人用户名。支持模糊匹配，仅返回审批节点中包含该审批人的审批流程
parameters.name: username
